key_insight: Accounting for the exact fluid–solid boundary location and correcting mass leakage improves hydrodynamic force accuracy in lattice Boltzmann simulations.
engineering_relevance: More reliable force evaluation supports simulations of complex geometries, moving boundaries, and fluid–structure interactions.
method: Analyze force errors caused by the conventional momentum-exchange method’s implicit midway-boundary assumption.
Modify momentum exchange to account for the exact boundary position along lattice links.
Add a mass-conservative correction to interpolation-supplemented bounce-back schemes.
evidence_signal: Benchmarks of increasing complexity, including flat and curved geometries, show improved force fidelity with the combined corrections, although the abstract reports no numerical error reductions.
watch_item: Implementation requires accurate boundary–link intersection locations and a mass-conservative bounce-back correction; moving-boundary performance is not quantified in the abstract.
paper_title: Improving the accuracy of the momentum-exchange method in lattice Boltzmann methods
